Mission Local reported that the State Bar had sent sitting District Attorney Brooke Jenkins into a diversionary program after ethics complaints, following a two-and-a-half-year process. Its story said the complaints would be “best resolved” by requiring her to participate; the State Bar said the program generally involved isolated misconduct and a low risk to public protection. Mission Local also noted that the remaining complaint concerned Jenkins’s accessing and emailing a confidential rap sheet.
